  Bas ek rishta Husain se hai

  Husain ko nazar meiṅ tum basaalo ae Husainiyoṅ

  Bas ek rishta Husain se hai

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/bas-ek-rishta-husain.md\")
original = path.read_bytes().decode(\"utf-8\")
metadata, separator, verses = original.partition(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\")
roman, boundary, source = verses.partition(\"\\n---\\n\")
assert separator and boundary
replacements = {
    \"Ana minal Husain\": \"Ana min al-Husain\",
    \"bithaalo\": \"bithaa lo\",
    \"basaalo\": \"basaa lo\",
    \"banaalo\": \"banaa lo\",
    \"Raheiṅge\": \"Raheiṅ ge\",
    \"paayega\": \"paaye ga\",
}
for old, new in replacements.items():
    assert roman.count(old) == 1, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
updated = metadata + separator + roman + boundary + source
assert updated.split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1] == original.split(\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1]
roman_blocks = roman.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
source_blocks = source.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 11
for number, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    roman_lines = roman_block.splitlines()
    source_lines = source_block.splitlines()
    assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines), number
    if number:
        assert roman_lines[0].strip() == str(number)
        assert source_lines[0] == str(number).translate(str.maketrans(\"0123456789\", \"۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\"))
assert all(ord(char) < 128 or char in \"ṅṄ\" for char in roman)
path.write_bytes(updated.encode(\"utf-8\"))
assert path.read_bytes().decode(\"utf-8\") == updated
PY

item.text:
Audited the Roman transliteration against the Urdu opening and all 10 stanzas. Corrected six word-boundary issues and verified verse-by-verse alignment. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved.

The reading `aana` for `آنا` in the final stanza remains uncertain and was left as supplied.
